title: BC Crown grazing and reforestation
description: Evidence review for forestry on grazing land, including lease terms, range plans, natural barriers and free-growing obligations.

facts.label: Is there an executed Land Act grazing lease covering the activity area?
Does a confirmed lease clause require a consent that is outstanding or restrict the proposed activity?
Does a confirmed Range Act licence or permit cover this activity area?
Does FRPA §29(0.1), (1) or (2) apply to the harvest and the net area to be reforested before considering exemptions?
Would the proposal keep any of the area to be reforested permanently open for grazing?
Is the area used, or will it be used, exclusively for grazing livestock or cutting hay under that Range Act agreement?
Is harvesting restricted to activities listed in FPPR §44(3), including the exclusive range-use harvest under paragraph (d)?
Does an applicable approved plan clause restrict the proposed harvest or silviculture, or impose an unmet prerequisite?
Would the proposed forest practice directly or indirectly remove or render ineffective a natural range barrier?
Does the 2006 Omineca ADA/SRA order apply to this Crown land and activity after checking the legal boundary, effective date and exclusions?
Does this scenario propose timber harvesting in the area covered by the order?
Was the harvest carried out, or is it proposed, under the order’s Part B forest-health pathway?
Does the activity include site preparation or artificial regeneration such as planting?

sources.title: Forest and Range Practices Act, SBC 2002 c. 69
BC Forest Planning and Practices Regulation
2006 Omineca Agriculture Development Areas and Settlement Reserve Areas Order

rules.title: Crown grazing lease terms
rules.finding: Review the executed grazing lease for the specific harvest or silviculture activity.

actions.description: Record the Crown lands file, signed lease and management plan. Check the legal boundary, current term, forest entry and timber rights, consent wording, access, forage and range improvements.

rules.title: Lease restriction or outstanding consent
rules.finding: The recorded lease terms raise an unresolved restriction for the proposed activity.

actions.description: Record the exact clause and the status of any consent, authorization or amendment with the Crown land administrator. Check older lease terms individually.

rules.title: Grazing or hay agreement and approved range plan
rules.finding: Review the governing range plan and dates alongside the forestry activity.

actions.description: Record the RAN file, agreement, approved range use or stewardship plan or documented exception, pasture boundaries, grazing or hay schedule, and range developments.

rules.title: Free-growing stand after harvest
rules.finding: Review the responsible holder’s free-growing obligation and any applicable exemption for the net area to be reforested.

actions.description: Record the timber authority, applicable plan and stocking standard, planting or natural regeneration method, regeneration and free-growing dates, and any transfer, relief or exemption.

rules.title: Permanent grazing opening in the reforestation area
rules.finding: Keeping the proposed footprint open would conflict with the free-growing obligation unless a separate legal basis applies.

actions.description: Before harvest, confirm the proposed opening and stocking standards with the district. Check whether a Range Act agreement authorizes exclusive grazing and whether FPPR §44(3)(d) applies. Verify clearing authority for the same footprint.

rules.title: Exclusive grazing or hay exemption
rules.finding: The entered evidence warrants review of this specific free-growing exemption.

actions.description: Confirm the legal footprint and exclusive use, the restricted purposes of harvest, and that the provision applies to the harvest. Review authority to harvest or carry out planting separately.

rules.title: Restriction in the applicable forest plan
rules.finding: The recorded plan clause restricts the proposed activity or requires a step before it can proceed.

actions.description: Record the approved plan, amendment and clause. Check whether retaining the barrier, changing the footprint or timing, carrying out the required measure, or obtaining a plan amendment resolves the conflict.

rules.title: Natural range barrier impact
rules.finding: The proposed practice triggers review of natural range barrier mitigation.

actions.description: Record evidence that the feature controls livestock movement, the approved operational-plan measure or minister’s authorization, and timing and responsibilities. For a forest stewardship plan, see FPPR §18. Check whether a pre-expiry permit carries the duty forward.

rules.title: Harvest pathway in an agriculture or settlement reserve area
rules.finding: Harvest in the covered area requires review against the order’s limited pathways.

actions.description: Check the Part A government proposal, interagency agreement and operational work plan, or the Part B forest-health basis and all Part C conditions. Record applicable permit exclusions and any documented Part E deviation.

rules.title: Site preparation and artificial regeneration under the forest-health pathway
rules.provision: I, Parts B, C.5 and E
rules.finding: Part C.5 restricts site preparation and artificial regeneration for this Part B forest-health harvest.

actions.description: Review the governing permit, stocking standard and approved plan. Document any applicable Part E departure and reconcile any free-growing duty with the responsible district before scheduling planting.
